mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals stronger economic activity, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase quarter-over-quarter in the past 6 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) crossing above 130,000 signals a robust labor market, stimulating consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 130,000 in the last month
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 130,000 in the last month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and increase in HOUST (demand) create a dual accommodative signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises while HOUST falls, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% signals further monetary accommodation, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1.0% in the regime, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) signals robust production and inventory buildup, reducing growth concerns and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not increase month-over-month for 3 consecutive months, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) and rise in PAYEMS (employment) above 130,000 signal a robust labor market, stimulating consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises while PAYEMS falls, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-stage expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% signals further accommodative policy, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 0.5% in the regime, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and fall in UNRATE (improving labor market) creates a dual accommodative signal, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE increases, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
